pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.description: This Privacy Policy explains how forgent collects, uses, stores, and protects information when providing AI automation and business automation services.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
content: This Privacy Policy describes how forgent collects, uses, stores, and protects personal and business information.
By using our website or services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
content: We may collect information directly from clients, website visitors, and authorized representatives of businesses.
list: Project requirements and business process information
CRM, sales, customer support, reporting, and workflow data provided by clients
Technical information such as IP addresses, browser type, device information, and usage data

sections.title: 3. How We Use Information
content: We use information only for legitimate business purposes related to our services.
list: Providing AI automation and workflow automation services
Building and maintaining AI agents and automation systems
Managing client projects and support requests
Protecting our services and systems from misuse

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Services
content: To provide our services, we may use third-party providers and platforms.
Information may be processed by these providers according to their own privacy policies and terms.
list: AI providers and language model providers

sections.title: 5. Cookies and Analytics
content: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience and understand website usage.
Users may manage cookie preferences through their browser settings.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
content: We retain information only for as long as necessary to provide services, fulfill contractual obligations, resolve disputes, maintain business records, and comply with legal requirements.
Retention periods may vary depending on the nature of the project and applicable laws.

sections.title: 7. Data Security
content: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure.
No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 8. International Data Transfers
content: Because we serve clients internationally and use global service providers, information may be transferred to and processed in countries different from the client's location.
By using our services, clients acknowledge and accept such transfers where legally permitted.

sections.title: 9. User Rights
content: Depending on applicable laws, users may have certain rights regarding their personal information.
list: Request deletion of information where applicable
Request information about how data is used

sections.title: 10. Client Data Responsibilities
content: Clients are responsible for ensuring that any data provided to forgent is collected and shared lawfully.
Clients remain responsible for their own compliance obligations related to customer, employee, or business data.

sections.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
Updated versions will become effective when published on our website.

sections.title: 12. Contact Information
content: Questions regarding this Privacy Policy may be sent to hello@forgentsystems.com

pages.title: Refund Policy
pages.description: This Refund Policy explains how refunds are handled for AI automation and custom business automation projects provided by forgent.

sections.title: 1. Overview
content: forgent provides custom AI automation, workflow automation, sales automation, customer support automation, reporting systems, AI agents, integrations, and related services.
Because services are customized for each client, refunds are handled based on completed project milestones.

sections.title: 2. Milestone-Based Payments
content: Projects may be divided into milestones, phases, or deliverables.
Payments are earned as work is completed and delivered.

sections.title: 3. Non-Refundable Work
content: Amounts related to completed work, delivered milestones, consultation time, planning, research, configuration, development, integrations, testing, or deployment are non-refundable.

sections.title: 4. Refund Eligibility
content: Refund requests may be considered only for work that has not yet been started or for future milestones that have not been delivered.
Approved refunds will be limited to the unused portion of project payments.

sections.title: 5. Third-Party Costs
content: Fees paid to third-party providers are not refundable through forgent.

sections.title: 6. Client Delays and Project Holds
content: If a client delays providing required information, approvals, access credentials, data, or feedback, project timelines may be extended.
Completed work remains billable even if the project is paused or delayed.

sections.title: 7. Project Cancellation
content: Clients may request cancellation at any time.
Upon cancellation, clients remain responsible for payment of all completed work and approved expenses incurred before cancellation.

sections.title: 8. Service Performance
content: AI systems, automation workflows, third-party platforms, APIs, and integrations may produce variable results.
Refunds will not be issued solely because business outcomes, sales performance, automation performance, or AI-generated outputs did not meet expectations.

sections.title: 9. Refund Requests
content: Refund requests must be submitted in writing with relevant project details and reasons for the request.
Each request will be reviewed based on project status, completed work, and contractual obligations.

sections.title: 10. Contact Information
content: Questions regarding this Refund Policy may be sent to hello@forgentsystems.com

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.description: These Terms of Service govern the use of forgent's AI automation and business automation services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
content: By accessing our website or using our services, you agree to these Terms of Service.
If you do not agree with these terms, you should not use our services.

sections.title: 2. Services
content: forgent provides AI automation and business automation services for organizations and businesses.

sections.title: 3. Project Scope
content: The scope of each project will be defined through proposals, agreements, statements of work, emails, or other written documentation.
Work outside the agreed scope may require additional fees, timelines, or approvals.

sections.title: 4. Client Responsibilities
content: Clients are responsible for providing information, approvals, access, and resources necessary for project completion.
list: Reviewing deliverables in a timely manner

sections.title: 5. Payments
content: Fees, payment schedules, and billing terms will be defined in project agreements.
Late payments may result in project delays, suspension of work, or termination of services.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Services
content: Our solutions may rely on third-party services, software, APIs, AI providers, hosting providers, CRMs, communication platforms, and automation tools.
We are not responsible for outages, policy changes, pricing changes, service interruptions, security incidents, or limitations caused by third-party providers.

sections.title: 7. AI and Automation Limitations
content: AI systems and automation workflows may generate inaccurate, incomplete, unexpected, or inconsistent outputs.
Clients are responsible for reviewing important outputs before relying on them for business, legal, financial, or operational decisions.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual Property
content: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, clients receive ownership of final deliverables after full payment of applicable project fees.
forgent retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, frameworks, templates, methodologies, internal systems, and general know-how used during project delivery.

sections.title: 9. Confidentiality
content: Both parties agree to protect confidential information shared during the course of a project.
Confidential information will not be disclosed except as required by law or with permission from the information owner.

sections.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, forgent shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or business-related damages.
Our total liability related to any claim shall not exceed the amount paid by the client for the specific services giving rise to the claim.

sections.title: 11. Termination
content: Either party may terminate a project or service arrangement with written notice.
Upon termination, payment obligations for completed work and incurred expenses remain due.

sections.title: 12. Governing Law
content: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, these terms shall be governed by applicable laws determined by the contractual relationship between the parties.

sections.title: 13. Changes to These Terms
content: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time.
Continued use of our services after updates become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.title: 14. Contact Information
content: Questions regarding these Terms of Service may be sent to hello@forgentsystems.com
